description: This is a low-level C source file implementing in-core 3-way file merge logic for Git, including built-in merge strategies, support for external merge drivers, merge configuration parsing, and merge execution functions.

classes.name: ll_merge_driver
classes.description: A structure representing a merge driver, including its name, description, associated function, command line, and recursive driver if any.

classes.name: attr_check
classes.description: A structure for attribute checking used during merge to determine the merge style.

classes.name: mmfile_t
classes.description: A structure representing a memory buffer for file content, with pointer and size.

classes.name: struct ll_merge_options
classes.description: Options controlling the merge operation, including renormalization and conflict marker size adjustments.

methods.name: struct:attr_check * load_merge_attributes(void)
methods.description: Lazy loads or initializes merge attribute checks used for merge configuration.

methods.name: void reset_merge_attributes(void)
methods.description: Resets the stored merge attributes, freeing resources.

methods.name: enum:ll_merge_result ll_binary_merge(const struct ll_merge_driver * drv UNUSED,mmbuffer_t * result,const char * path UNUSED,mmfile_t * orig,const char * orig_name UNUSED,mmfile_t * src1,const char * name1 UNUSED,mmfile_t * src2,const char * name2 UNUSED,const struct ll_merge_options * opts,int marker_size UNUSED)
methods.description: Performs a binary merge, determining conflicts or acceptance based on options.

methods.name: enum:ll_merge_result ll_xdl_merge(const struct ll_merge_driver * drv_unused,mmbuffer_t * result,const char * path,mmfile_t * orig,const char * orig_name,mmfile_t * src1,const char * name1,mmfile_t * src2,const char * name2,const struct ll_merge_options * opts,int marker_size)
methods.description: Performs a 3-way text merge using the xdl (external diff3) algorithm, falling back to binary merge on binary files.

methods.name: enum:ll_merge_result ll_union_merge(const struct ll_merge_driver * drv_unused,mmbuffer_t * result,const char * path,mmfile_t * orig,const char * orig_name,mmfile_t * src1,const char * name1,mmfile_t * src2,const char * name2,const struct ll_merge_options * opts,int marker_size)
methods.description: Performs a union merge combining changes from both sides.

methods.name: void create_temp(mmfile_t * src,char * path,size_t len)
methods.description: Creates a temporary file with the content of a given mmfile.

methods.name: enum:ll_merge_result ll_ext_merge(const struct ll_merge_driver * fn,mmbuffer_t * result,const char * path,mmfile_t * orig,const char * orig_name,mmfile_t * src1,const char * name1,mmfile_t * src2,const char * name2,const struct ll_merge_options * opts,int marker_size)
methods.description: Handles external merge driver invocation with command line interpolation.

methods.name: int read_merge_config(const char * var,const char * value,const struct config_context * ctx UNUSED,void * cb UNUSED)
methods.description: Reads merge-related configuration settings from git config.

methods.name: void initialize_ll_merge(void)
methods.description: Initializes or loads the set of user-defined merge drivers.

methods.name: const struct ll_merge_driver * find_ll_merge_driver(const char * merge_attr)
methods.description: Finds the appropriate merge driver based on attribute name.

methods.name: void normalize_file(mmfile_t * mm,const char * path,struct index_state * istate)
methods.description: Normalizes buffer contents, e.g., line endings, for proper merging.

methods.name: enum:ll_merge_result ll_merge(mmbuffer_t * result_buf,const char * path,mmfile_t * ancestor,const char * ancestor_label,mmfile_t * ours,const char * our_label,mmfile_t * theirs,const char * their_label,struct index_state * istate,const struct ll_merge_options * opts)
methods.description: Main entry point performing the merge given ancestor, ours, and theirs buffers and options.

methods.name: int ll_merge_marker_size(struct index_state * istate,const char * path)
methods.description: Retrieves conflict marker size attribute for a given file.
